verdict.rationale: Cross-border reach is a fair question for a law firm, so the axis applies. The firm describes itself as "a national U.S. law firm" whose seven offices are all in U.S. cities (New York, Palo Alto, Roseland, Salt Lake City, San Francisco, Washington D.C., Wilmington). Its mention of managing "national and global trademark portfolios" is one practice area, not foreign offices or qualified practices in other countries, so nothing shows that expanding abroad would avoid hiring a second firm.
